scenes.title: VLOOKUP in 2 Seconds
scenes.subtitle: Find anything in a long list, instantly
scenes.vo: Namaste! Aaj hum seekhenge VLOOKUP, Excel ka sabse kaam ka formula.
Socho aapke paas paanch sau students ki list hai, aur ek ki fees dhoondhni hai. Scroll karte karte das minute?

scenes.head: MEET RIYA
scenes.say: Itni lambi list mein fees kaise dhoondhu?
scenes.vo: Ye hai Riya. Uska boss roz poochta hai, is student ki fees kitni hai? Aur Riya har baar scroll karti hai.

scenes.title: How VLOOKUP thinks
scenes.vo: VLOOKUP teen sawaal poochta hai. Kya dhoondhna hai? Kahan dhoondhna hai? Aur kaunsa column wapas laana hai?

scenes.title: Remember
scenes.vo: Teen baatein yaad rakho. Naam pehle column mein ho. Column left se gino. Aur end mein FALSE likho, matlab exact match.
Isse aap kuch bhi nikaal sakte ho: fees, marks, phone number, ya city.
Formula simple hai: naam, plus list, plus column, barabar answer.

scenes.title: The formula
scenes.vo: Ye raha formula. Riya, matlab kya dhoondhna hai. A2 se C500, matlab list. Aur teen, matlab teesra column, fees.

scenes.head: TRY IT IN EXCEL
scenes.vo: Excel mein ye formula likho, enter dabao, aur answer turant aa jayega.
Do second. Koi galti nahi. Fees mil gayi. Aur boss khush.

scenes.title: Time to find one fee
scenes.vo: Scroll karne mein chhe sau second, Control F se saath second, aur VLOOKUP se sirf do second.
Teen steps: cell pe click, formula type, enter.

scenes.name: Boss

messages.text: Riya, Kabir ki fees kitni hai?

scenes.vo: Ab boss poochta hai, Kabir ki fees? Riya do second mein bata deti hai. Itni jaldi? Great!
Galat tareeka: naam pehle column mein nahi, aur end mein TRUE. Sahi tareeka: naam pehle column mein, aur end mein FALSE.

scenes.question: What does 3 mean in the formula?
scenes.vo: Quiz time! Formula mein teen ka matlab kya hai? Socho... Sahi jawab hai, teesra column.
Recap. VLOOKUP dhoondhta hai aur laata hai. Kya, kahan, kaunsa column. Aur FALSE matlab exact match.
Aapka kaam: das students ki list banao, unki fees likho, aur ek ki fees VLOOKUP se nikaalo.

scenes.title: HLOOKUP and XLOOKUP
scenes.vo: Agle video mein seekhenge HLOOKUP aur XLOOKUP. Milte hain!
